description: Adds a logo: the Primary (the main mark, the one Marsell uses), or its Light, Dark or Symbol version. SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP, from a public https url or its bytes. An SVG with styles, classes or nested drawings is drawn to a 2048 px PNG on a clear background, and the answer says so. For files on the agent's own machine, get_upload_link gives an address to send them to from your shell, so nothing big passes through your messages.

data_base64.description: Or the file's bytes, base64 (as large as one MCP message carries, about 4 MB).

filename.description: Its file name with its extension, when you have one.

label.description: What this version is for, when it helps.

url.description: A public https address of the file. Marsell fetches it itself (public addresses only, up to 8 MB).

variant.description: Primary unless it is a light, dark or symbol version.

name: add_logo
title: Add a logo
